items.headline: QB Isaiah Marshall's career rushing day leads Kansas over West Virginia 37-14
items.description: — Isaiah Marshall rushed for a career-high 164 yards and one touchdown, Khijohnn Cummings-Coleman and Chase Belcher each scored twice on the ground and Kansas beat West Virginia 37-14 on Saturday.
